_comment: Your screener. Edit this file on GitHub's website and it takes effect on the next run. Nothing here is secret.
_comment_leadTimes: Minutes before a mint opens that you want warning. Two-stage: a research heads-up, then a get-ready ping.

freshness._comment: How new something must be to count as 'early'.

hardRejects._comment: Binary disqualifiers, checked before scoring. Cheap way to kill obvious spam.

weights._comment: Must sum to 100. uniqueMinterRatio is the best cheap wash-mint tell, so it carries the most.

velocity._comment: Rolling window used by real-time stream mode to spot a mint going live.

priceSanity._comment: Mint prices in ETH that historically correlate with real projects rather than spam or cash-grabs.
priceSanity._comment_decay: Price at which the price score hits zero. Keep this well below maxMintPriceEth or expensive mints barely lose any points.

risk._comment: Deal-breakers. These MULTIPLY the score instead of adding to it, so one bad finding can veto five good ones. Raise a penalty toward 1 to make it milder.
risk._comment_bots: A free mint being claimed faster than this is usually one operator running scripts, not real demand.

retention._comment: Days to remember a contract so you are not alerted twice. Keeps the state file small.

budget._comment: Max OpenSea API requests per poll run. The free tier allows ~600/hour and 5-minute polling means 12 runs/hour, so keep this at or below 45.
